dashboard.filter_chips_content: Active filters appear as chips here. Click × to remove one, or use '+ Add filter' to narrow by status, job type, repository, and more.
dashboard.view_switcher_content: Switch between a table view and a Kanban board. Kanban gives you an at-a-glance overview of where your epics stand — and lets you drag epics between Backlog, Ready, and In Progress.
dashboard.create_actions_content: 'New Job' opens a quick-start form; 'New Epic' groups related jobs together. The recommended way to create jobs and epics is through Chat — describe your task there and Syrus turns it into a pull request.
dashboard.job_row_title: Click any job to dive in
dashboard.job_row_content: Opening a job shows the full implementation timeline, the pull request diff, and lets you give feedback or approve the work.
